from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [
        Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for c in range(w)
    ]

    row_counts = Counter(row_modes)
    col_counts = Counter(col_modes)
    row_line_color = min(row_counts, key=row_counts.get)
    col_line_color = min(col_counts, key=col_counts.get)

    rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == row_line_color]
    cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == col_line_color]

    line_color = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols).most_common(1)[0][0]
    interior = Counter(
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in cols
    )
    background = interior.most_common(1)[0][0]

    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    blocks = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            color = nodes[i][j]
            if (color == nodes[i + 1][j] == nodes[i][j + 1] == nodes[i + 1][j + 1]
                    and color != line_color and color != background):
                blocks.append((i, j, color))

    min_r = min(i for i, j, color in blocks)
    max_r = max(i for i, j, color in blocks)
    min_c = min(j for i, j, color in blocks)
    max_c = max(j for i, j, color in blocks)

    out = [[background] * (max_c - min_c + 1) for _ in range(max_r - min_r + 1)]
    for i, j, color in blocks:
        out[i - min_r][j - min_c] = color
    return out

from collections import Counter
from math import sqrt

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [
        Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for c in range(w)
    ]

    def regularity(positions):
        gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(positions, positions[1:])]
        if not gaps:
            return 10.0
        mean = sum(gaps) / len(gaps)
        variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in gaps) / len(gaps)
        return sqrt(variance) / mean + 0.1 / mean

    candidates = set(row_modes) & set(col_modes)
    best_color = None
    best_score = float("inf")
    for color in candidates:
        rs = [i for i, x in enumerate(row_modes) if x == color]
        cs = [i for i, x in enumerate(col_modes) if x == color]
        if len(rs) < 2 or len(cs) < 2:
            continue
        score = regularity(rs) + regularity(cs)
        if score < best_score:
            best_score, best_color = score, color

    line_color = best_color
    rows = [i for i, x in enumerate(row_modes) if x == line_color]
    cols = [i for i, x in enumerate(col_modes) if x == line_color]

    interior = [
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in cols
    ]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]

    nodes = []
    for r in rows:
        nodes.append([
            background if grid[r][c] == line_color else grid[r][c]
            for c in cols
        ])

    marked = [
        (i, j)
        for i, row in enumerate(nodes)
        for j, value in enumerate(row)
        if value != background
    ]
    min_i = min(i for i, j in marked)
    max_i = max(i for i, j in marked)
    min_j = min(j for i, j in marked)
    max_j = max(j for i, j in marked)

    out = []
    for i in range(min_i, max_i):
        row = []
        for j in range(min_j, max_j):
            a, b = nodes[i][j], nodes[i][j + 1]
            c, d = nodes[i + 1][j], nodes[i + 1][j + 1]
            if a == b == c == d and a != background:
                row.append(a)
            else:
                row.append(background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
